version: 1
rules:
- id: B-PRINT
  title: print() in library code
  severity: required
  decidability: deterministic
  applies_to:
  - src/**/*.py
  exclude:
  - src/**/cli.py
  - src/**/__main__.py
  check:
    engine: ast
    rule: call
    names:

  message: Use the logging module (logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)) instead of print().
  fixtures:
    fail:

- id: B-SWALLOW
  title: Exception silently swallowed
  severity: required
  decidability: deterministic
  applies_to:
  - src/**/*.py
  check:
    engine: ast
    rule: broad-except-pass
  message: Handle the error or re-raise it; do not catch Exception and pass.

`TokenBucket` is implemented in `src/ratelimit/bucket.py`, with the new tests in `tests/test_token_bucket.py`. `python -m pytest -q` passes: 19 tests, including the existing one.

- **Refill:** the bucket starts full and refills at `rate` per second, capped at `capacity`. Time is read only through the injected `clock`.
- **`try_acquire(n=1)`:** removes `n` tokens and returns `True` if available; otherwise returns `False` and removes nothing.
- **`wait_time(n=1)`:** returns `0.0` if `n` tokens are available now, otherwise the seconds until they will be. It does not remove tokens.
- **`tokens`:** a property returning the refilled count as a float.
- **Validation:** `rate` and `capacity` must be positive; `n` must be positive and at most `capacity`. Violations raise `ValueError`. `wait_time` applies the same `n` check as `try_acquire`.
